investment_en: Curate existing measured conductivity data for screening in known families
investment_zh: 整理已有实测电导率数据，用于已知家族的计算筛选
rationale_en: In known families, prior data saves far more experiments than algorithm differences.
rationale_zh: 已知家族里，先验数据省下的实验远多于算法差别。
continue_if_en: With the new data, a series-held-out backtest still beats the family rule and the intervals stop overlapping.
continue_if_zh: 加入新数据后，按系列留出的回测仍优于家族规则，且区间不再重叠。
stop_if_en: Still indistinguishable from the family rule when series are held out.
stop_if_zh: 按系列留出时仍和家族规则分不出来。

investment_en: Run a small set of exploration samples when entering a new chemical family
investment_zh: 进入新化学家族时先安排一小组探索性样本
rationale_en: Whether transfer works cannot be predicted: sulfides yes, oxides no.
rationale_zh: 迁移是否有效事先看不出来：硫化物有效，氧化物无效。
continue_if_en: The model's ranking matches measurements in the first few experiments.
continue_if_zh: 前几次实验里模型排序和实测一致。
stop_if_en: Rankings disagree: fall back to the family rule or random exploration.
stop_if_zh: 排序不一致：退回家族规则或随机探索。

rationale_en: One policy trained; no stable advantage.
rationale_zh: 只训练了一个策略，没有稳定优势。
continue_if_en: After a multi-seed rerun, beats screening on official, cv5 and series-grouped splits.
continue_if_zh: 多种子重做后，在官方、cv5 和按系列分组上都优于计算筛选。
stop_if_en: Fails to beat screening on any split.
stop_if_zh: 任一划分上不优于计算筛选。

investment_en: Partnership talks with a battery maker (joint exploration only)
investment_zh: 和电池厂谈合作（只谈联合探索）
rationale_en: The battery gate found buyer-side cell metrics (700 cycles, ≤20% loss; USABC targets); the named material limit is interface durability, which needs a partner's cell engineering.
rationale_zh: 电池关卡找到了买家侧的电芯指标（700 次循环、损失 ≤ 20%；USABC 目标）；买家点名的材料限制是界面耐久性，需要伙伴的电芯工程能力。
continue_if_en: The partner agrees milestones on cell-level metrics with stated test conditions (temperature, C-rate).
continue_if_zh: 伙伴同意按带测试条件（温度、倍率）的电芯级指标设里程碑。
stop_if_en: No partner will commit to cell-level test conditions, or the talks require claims beyond the conductivity evidence.
stop_if_zh: 没有伙伴愿意确定电芯级测试条件，或谈判要求超出电导率证据的承诺。

investment_en: Improve general models' κ scores to find thermal materials
investment_zh: 为找导热材料提升通用模型的 κ 分数
rationale_en: Better models already agree; the test set is too easy to prove more.
rationale_zh: 较好的模型排序已一致；测试集太容易，证明不了更多。
continue_if_en: On a harder dataset with complex structures, model rankings diverge.
continue_if_zh: 在更难、含复杂结构的数据集上，模型排序分歧变大。

rationale_en: No primary evidence that buyers need a new material.
rationale_zh: 没有一手证据表明买家需要新材料。
continue_if_en: A buyer (not a supplier) publicly names a material as the limit and will pay for it.
continue_if_zh: 一个买家（不是供应商）公开说某种材料是限制并愿意付钱。

investment_en: Build known high-conductivity materials into devices
investment_zh: 已知高导热材料的器件化
rationale_en: Buyers point to cooling architecture; the only payment evidence is a supplier's.
rationale_zh: 买家指向冷却架构；唯一的付钱证据来自供应商。
continue_if_en: Diamond-cooled servers get an independent test reported as OCP thermal resistance or junction temperature.
continue_if_zh: 金刚石散热服务器有按 OCP 热阻或结温报告的独立测试。

investment_en: Physics of the thermal reference calculation (four-phonon, defects)
investment_zh: 热导率参考计算的物理（四声子、缺陷）
rationale_en: Would raise trust in computation but does not change near-term decisions.
rationale_zh: 能提高计算可信度，但不改变近期决策。
continue_if_en: Restart when chip cooling returns to priority.
continue_if_zh: 散热回到优先时再启动。

investment_en: Add the random-removal control and repeated seeds the CSP paper lacks
investment_zh: 补做 CSP 论文缺的随机移除对照和多种子重训
rationale_en: These two controls decide whether 'prototype dependence' holds. Pre-registered 2026-11-21 (7 core runs); cost not yet measured: a smoke test comes first, then a go-ahead.
rationale_zh: 这两项对照决定"原型依赖"能否成立。2026-11-21 已预登记（核心 7 次训练）；花费还没测，先做冒烟测试，再等批准。
continue_if_en: Prototype dependence survives the controls: then test generators further from known prototypes.
continue_if_zh: 对照后原型依赖仍成立：再在离已知原型更远处测试生成模型。
stop_if_en: The drop disappears under a size-matched random removal, or our runner cannot reproduce the paper's arms (G0).
stop_if_zh: 同等规模随机移除下下降消失，或我们的流程复现不了论文的两组结果（G0）。

investment_zh: 更大规模的晶体筛选算力
rationale_en: On substitution-generated candidates, small budgets are already 95%+ stable with many models; no evidence yet on candidates far from known prototypes.
rationale_zh: 在元素替换生成的候选上，许多模型的小预算已 95% 以上稳定；离已知原型远的候选还没有证据。
continue_if_en: A test set far from known prototypes shows models still separate and add value there.
continue_if_zh: 离已知原型更远的测试集显示模型在那里仍有区分和增量价值。
stop_if_en: Models fail on that test set as badly as templates.
stop_if_zh: 模型在那个测试集上和模板一样失败。

investment_en: Synthesis and structure confirmation partner for top DFT-stable candidates
investment_zh: 为 DFT 稳定的头部候选找合成与结构确认伙伴
rationale_en: DFT stability is gate 2–3; synthesisability is not answered by computation. Untested in this project.
rationale_zh: DFT 稳定只到第 2–3 关；能否合成计算回答不了。本项目未检验。
continue_if_en: A literature backtest shows a useful share of DFT-stable predictions get synthesised.
continue_if_zh: 文献回测显示 DFT 稳定的预测有可观比例被合成出来。
